notes.title: Release Patch Notes May 21
notes.content:
[b]User Interface:[/b]
- Creating a new style for some pop-up windows and common interfaces
- Fixed some texts displayed in the game
- Fixed some localized texts

[b]Tutorials: [/b]
- Fixed a bug that displayed wrong turns during the tutorials

[b]Cards:[/b]
- (Dawnlight) Pilgrimage fixed, now allows you to put the card on opponent's allies
- (Dawnlight) Caedosa fixed, the card rule is according to what the card do
- (Shadowcell) Dispute Resolution fixed, was drawing two cards even if they didn't match the filled card
- (Shadowcell) Number 198 fixed, cards to kill are now following the card rule
- (Alphaguard) Allied Soldier fixed, it cannot move protected cards anymore
- (Neutral) Particulizer fixed, now it duplicates cards even if they have more than 10.000 points in value
- (Dawnlight) Elaheem fixed, cannot be played anymore if the opponent board is empty
- (Dawnlight) Acquisition fixed, order of actions remade
- (Alphaguard) Criterion fixed, isn't protecting cards for the entire game anymore

[b]BattleStage:[/b]
- Fixed a bug causing the BattleStage to reset and play against the first boss
- Fixed a bug causing the Challenge button to not work in the interface
- Fixed a bug with the timer and towers creations

[b]Account Creations:[/b]
- Solved a bug preventing some players to create accounts with specific names

[b]Mission System:[/b]
- Now Value Change missions are working properly

notes.title: Release Patch Notes Apr 9
notes.content:
[b]User Interface:[/b]

- Fixed a bug causing the "Give Up" dialogue to display in different languages
- Fixed some responsivness errors with spanish localization
- Fixed a bug causing some letters to disappear
- Fixed a bug causing the DNA and Credits to disappear

[b]Syindicates: [/b]

- Adding a new Leaderboard showing the syndicate ranks

[b]Cards:[/b]

- (Razorcorp) Nocturne now allows you to put the card on opponent's allies
- (Alphaguard) The Enticer fixed, it was taking cards to loyalist even without faction icons
- (Shadowcell) Imitator fixed, was causing a disconnection error
- (Razorcorp/Alphaguard) Manipulator fixed, was causing the faction card to keep in hand

[b]BattleStage:[/b]

- Fixed a bug causing the BattleStage to reset and play against the first boss

notes.title: Release Patch Notes Apr 1
notes.content:
[b]PvP Cards:[/b]

- (Dawnlight) Fallen Angel now returns the card to its original color from Brown when it leaves the row.
- (Alphaguard) Life Dealer now is also activated when a card dies even if it came from the Afterlife.
- (Alphaguard) Mystic Imager bug fixed that prevented her from being played.

[b]Battlestage:[/b]

- When a DRAW between the Character and Player occurs, the Battlestage will not advance the player but will allow them to challenge the Character again at no cost.

[b]UI Fixes:[/b]

- Fixed several images in the Accessibility Menu
- Fixed particles and pack animation
- Fixed a bug preventing the player to return to the Leaderboard after viewing other player profiles
- Fixed Battlestage building mouse detection areas
- Fixed some Community Skins lore content

[b]Localization:[/b]

- Fixed Font Accents and Missing Characters

[b]Chat:[/b]

- When the return key is pressed, the game will remain in the chat window for continual chat without requiring the user to click the window again
- The chat history is automatically scrolled down when the player opens it.

notes.title: Release Patch Notes Mar 16
notes.content:
[b]AI Cards:[/b]

- Fixed AI Trenchcoat now change the color to another random one not choosing the same one.
- Fixed AI Brainwash now only kills cards in Recruits.
- Fixed AI Divinity now can't played with less than 4 cards on neutral area.
- Fixed AI Replacement now doesn't choose protected cards.

[b]UI Fixed:[/b]

- Fixed a bug causing the DNA to appear twice when the player finish a stage on battlestage mode.
- Fixed a bug causing Match History displaying wrong when the match uses extra time.
- Fixing a bug causing the winning and lossing interface appears twice when the opponent surrender.

[b]Localization:[/b]

- Reworking all spanish text to be more accurate.
- Fixing some spanish text to now show accents.

notes.title: Release Patch Notes Mar 9
notes.content:
[b]PvP Cards:[/b]

- Fixed a bug causing Kiytana to not be playable if there are 3 cards on neutrals with a total value lower than 20.

[b]AI Cards:[/b]

- Fixed AI Deliverance cheating cause AI knows what card whas in top of community deck.

[b]UI Fixed:[/b]

- Fixed a bug causing the Add Friend/Report window appears at the begining of the match.
- Fixed a bug causing the progress bar on Battlestage not to update when get into a new tower.

[b]Matching and Connection:[/b]

- Fixing a bug causing one player to freeze when the match ends.
- Fixing a bug causing players to duplicate their state on the server when they enter on a recorded match.
- Fixing a bug causing players to loss conection with the server too quick. 

[b]Battlestage:[/b]

- Fixed a bug causing the battlestage to finish one challenge before the final one.

notes.title: Release Patch2 Notes Mar 5
notes.content:
[b]Leaderboards:[/b]

- Fixed a bug causing the ranked leaderboard to show levels.
- Fixed a bug causing the ranks separator shows up on the normal leaderboard.

[b]Game Navigation:[/b]

- Fixed a bug preventing the player to exit the game.

[b]Texts:[/b]

- Fixing game typos.
- Fixing report user button.
- Fixing some Spanish text localization.

notes.title: Release Patch Notes Mar 5
notes.content:
[b]PvP Cards:[/b]

- Fixed a bug causing Kill and Advance not to select 1 Loyalist card as possible killing target
- Fixed a bug causing +5/-5 cards triggered from another Faction card to allow you choose opponent's Recruits as a possible row

[b]AI Cards:[/b]

- Fixed AI Caedosa, now behaves exactly like the PvP version
- Fixed AI Absorption, now behaves exactly like the PvP version
- Fixed Killing Spree, now the AI chooses correctly which cards to kill
- Fixed Kill and Advance, now killed cards can be revived from Afterlife
- Fixed Kill and Restore, now killed cards can be revived from Afterlife
- Fixed Voiceless Sorrow, now moves the card to your allies

[b]DNA from Cards:[/b]

- Now duplicates and extracted epic cards give you the same amount of DNA (40)

[b]UI Fixed:[/b]

- Main Menu Play Button now it's separated from home button
- Now Faction Cards Collection filters reorder the cards properly

[b]Matching and Connection:[/b]

- Fixed a bug causing the players to stay connected even if they close the application
- Fixed a bug causing you to lose when the opponent close the application
- Fixed a bug causing the Defeating UI to appear twice when player surrender

notes.title: Release Patch Notes Mar 3
notes.content:
[b]Battlestage:[/b]

- Fixed UI displacement problem
- Fixed a bug causing the player to win twice after the first match

[b]Starter Pack:[/b]

- Now the game offers you a starter pack limited promotion!

[b]PvP Cards Fixed:[/b]

- Mongoose game breaking
- Birdwatcher no longer removes your own own cards

[b]AI Cards Fixed:[/b]

- The Watchee no longer take cards from allies to the neutral area
- Pilgrimage is no longer played if there are less than 3 cards in the Afterlife
- Voiceless Sorrow now picks 3 random cards instead of the 3 most valuable ones
- Head of the Snake now longer works in the opposite way
